ops.text: The growth is Python-level file parsing inside the product worker, run by the lane-rotation hooks (escalate_unrotated_lanes, note_flushed_lanes, ask_lanes_to_rotate) on root monorepo/sole. It is not transcript warming and not the snapshot owner: it reappeared within two minutes on 12.93.3, which has no worker-side warmer, on worker 61683 (13.3 GiB RSS, up to 4.2 GiB/min disk reads, footprint under 2 GiB). That worker holds the session's rotation_state.json.lock, a stack sample shows read(2) plus the json scanner on text lines, and 15 of the 17 dispatches of 20 s or more after the deploy are on that root with those hooks abandoned. Established to that depth only: the large file the hooks read line by line is not named, and the hook source was not read. The hooks live outside captain-hook, so the fix belongs with their owner.
